notes: Ludum Dare 46 Compo game Doggo by Alexander Erlemann (TheDarkWeasel) (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/46/doggo; https://d4rkweasel.itch.io/doggo). Complete Unity 2019.3.10f1 project under Doggo/Doggo/ with playable TitleScene, ExplanationScene, and MainScene in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2020 Alexander Erlemann). The author states everything here, including music, sounds, and assets, was created by them in 48 hours. Official Unity packages only in Doggo/Doggo/Packages/manifest.json (TextMesh Pro 2.0.1 as a package not vendored into Assets, Timeline, uGUI, IDE packages, test framework, collab-proxy, and built-in modules). No bundled fonts. Original Blender models and Sounds (including .ceol) at the repo root are retained. Unity Logs/ omitted. No DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~13M src snapshot.
